name: Roadgrip Tyres Ltd.
description: Roadgrip Tyres Ltd. is a Chennai-headquartered tyre manufacturer producing passenger car, SUV, EV-specific, two-wheeler, truck and bus radial and OTR tyres for vehicle OEMs, fleet operators and replacement distributors across India and export markets.

profile.summary: Roadgrip Tyres designs and manufactures tyres for passenger cars, SUVs, electric vehicles, two-wheelers, trucks, buses and off-the-road mining and construction equipment. Three plants in Tamil Nadu and Gujarat produce 42 million tyres a year. Roadgrip supplies original-equipment fitment to more than 20 vehicle makers and runs cost-per-km tyre programmes for truck, bus and ride-hailing fleets, backed by retreading, on-site tyre management and a 4,800-outlet replacement network.
valueProps: EV-specific tyres with low rolling resistance and acoustic foam that add up to 6% range and cut cabin noise
Co-development with OEM platform teams from concept to SOP, with dedicated application engineers
Cost-per-km fleet programmes that bundle new tyres, retreading, pressure monitoring and field service
Plants within 500 km of major OEM clusters in Chennai, Pune, Hosur and NCR for just-in-time supply
Full range under one supplier: car, SUV, EV, two-wheeler, truck and bus radial, and OTR
differentiators: In-house compound lab and indoor pass-by noise test track in Chennai
IATF 16949, ISO 14001 and BIS certified plants with PPAP-ready documentation
Retreadable truck and bus radial casings rated for three retreads
OTR sizes up to 57-inch rim produced in India, cutting lead times versus imports
Telematics-linked tyre pressure and tread monitoring for fleets

products.name: Roadgrip EcoVolt EV Series
products.description: Low rolling resistance passenger and SUV tyres engineered for electric vehicles, with high-load construction, silica-rich tread and an acoustic foam insert that reduces cabin noise by up to 4 dB.
products.priceNotes: OEM pricing quoted per platform on annual volume; replacement MRP from INR 6,800 per tyre (15-inch) to INR 18,500 (20-inch).

products.name: Roadgrip Terrain SUV & Passenger Range
products.description: Highway-terrain and all-terrain radials for hatchbacks, sedans and SUVs in 13- to 20-inch sizes, balancing wet grip, tread life and comfort for Indian road conditions.
products.priceNotes: Replacement MRP from INR 3,200 to INR 14,000; OEM price indexed quarterly to natural rubber and carbon black.

products.name: Roadgrip Moto Series
products.description: Tubeless scooter and motorcycle tyres from 10 to 21 inches, including dual-purpose adventure patterns and low rolling resistance compounds for electric scooters.
products.priceNotes: Replacement MRP from INR 1,100 to INR 9,500; OEM pricing per model and annual volume.

products.name: Roadgrip HaulMax TBR
products.description: Truck and bus radial tyres for long-haul, regional, city bus and tipper applications, with casings designed for three retreads and optional embedded pressure sensors.
products.priceNotes: Fleet cost-per-km contracts from INR 0.38/km (long-haul) to INR 0.55/km (tipper); outright price from INR 21,000 per tyre.

products.name: Roadgrip Titan OTR
products.description: Radial and bias OTR tyres for rigid dump trucks, wheel loaders, graders and excavators up to 57-inch rim, with cut-resistant compounds for mining and quarry use.
products.priceNotes: Quoted per tender; indicative floor margins and rebate bands held by the OTR key account team.

products.name: Roadgrip FleetCare Tyre Management
products.description: Managed tyre service combining telematics pressure monitoring, scheduled rotation and alignment, retreading and on-site technicians at fleet depots and mine pits.
products.priceNotes: Per-vehicle per-month fee from INR 450 (cars) to INR 2,400 (heavy trucks); discount ladder for 1,000+ vehicles is internal.

plans.name: OEM Platform Partner
plans.pricing: Platform-specific piece price with annual raw-material indexation; tooling co-funded 50:50 above 1 lakh units per annum.

plans.name: Fleet Cost-per-km Programme
plans.pricing: Fixed INR per km by application, reviewed semi-annually; minimum 200 vehicles or 24-month term.

plans.name: OTR Mine Site Assurance
plans.pricing: Per-hour or per-tonne-hauled contracts linked to tender terms; consignment stock at site.

policies.title: Roadgrip Product Warranty
policies.body: All Roadgrip passenger, SUV, EV and two-wheeler tyres carry a five-year warranty against manufacturing defects from the date of invoice, with pro-rata replacement based on remaining tread depth. Truck and bus radials are covered for three years and one retread. Road hazard damage, improper inflation, misalignment and competition use are excluded. Claims are processed at any authorised Roadgrip outlet within seven working days.

policies.title: OEM and Fleet Credit & Payment Terms
policies.body: Standard OEM payment terms are 45 days from delivery against monthly consolidated invoicing, extendable to 60 days for platform partners above INR 50 crore annual business with CFO approval. Fleet programmes are billed monthly on actual kilometres with 30-day terms and a security deposit equal to one month's estimated billing. Raw-material price indexation is applied quarterly using the published natural rubber index. Any deviation requires Sales Director and Finance sign-off.

policies.title: Quality Certifications & Traceability
policies.body: All three Roadgrip plants are certified to IATF 16949, ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001, and products carry BIS certification, ECE R30/R54/R117 and GCC conformity marks where applicable. Every tyre carries a unique DOT code and batch barcode traceable to compound batch, curing press and shift. OEM customers receive full PPAP Level 3 documentation and annual process audits.

icps.name: Vehicle OEMs launching or expanding platforms
icps.description: Passenger vehicle, EV, two-wheeler and commercial vehicle makers launching new models, opening plants or localising production in India, who need OE tyre nominations.

icps.name: High-mileage fleet operators
icps.description: Ride-hailing, logistics, last-mile delivery and bus operators running large fleets where tyre cost per km and downtime materially affect margins.

icps.name: Mining & construction equipment
icps.description: Mining contractors and earthmoving equipment makers that need OTR tyres with assured supply and on-site service for large equipment fleets.

customSignals.name: Ride-hailing fleet electrification
customSignals.description: A ride-hailing or cab fleet operator commits to converting a meaningful share of its fleet to electric vehicles.
customSignals.matchInstructions: Match when a ride-hailing, cab or shared-mobility operator announces plans to add or convert to electric cabs at fleet scale (typically 500+ vehicles), sets up EV charging-and-service depots for its fleet, or signs EV supply agreements. Do NOT match funding rounds, driver disputes, app features, or city-level EV statistics without a named operator commitment.

customSignals.name: Mining equipment tender
customSignals.description: A mining contractor, mine owner or equipment OEM floats or wins a tender for haul trucks, dumpers, loaders or OTR tyres.
customSignals.matchInstructions: Match when a mining company, mine developer-operator or earthmoving equipment maker floats, bids for or wins a tender or large order for dump trucks, haul trucks, excavators, loaders or OTR tyre supply. Do NOT match mineral price news, royalty or regulatory changes, mine accidents, or exploration licence awards without equipment procurement.
